notes: The owner's reframe was that "Processes and the event processing engine itself are ways to invoke smalltalk programs based upon observed changes in the data … we should have a 'process' package with the processes actually implemented in smalltalk." This is that package. THE MEASUREMENT IS WHY IT IS TRACTABLE: the eighteen declared process entry bodies are 345 lines in total, median 20, three of them THREE LINES, each delegating to one host module. A process is already a DECLARATION plus an INVOCATION, and what moves into the image is the invocation's DECISIONS. PLAN then PERFORM then SETTLE —
